name: ACEvo
description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to synthesize heuristic programs, yet most existing pipelines optimize solvers against fixed benchmark distributions. This static setup can obscure solver weaknesses and limit understanding of how LLM-designed algorithms adapt under distribution shift. We present Adversarial Co-Evolution (ACEvo), a closed-loop framework in which LLMs iteratively co-evolve two types of executable programs: heuristic solvers and problem generators.
